record_kind: explicit allowlisted immutable native-supported-controls evidence archive index

archive_policy.selection: Exact individual regular-file allowlist only; no directory tar/add recursion, inherited archive nesting, absolute member names, traversal or links.
archive_policy.original_bytes: All original receipts, handoff, reviews, native exports, actual PNGs and tooling are byte-identical to origins. No raw status or timestamp is rewritten. Absolute origin paths/PIDs/nonsecret fixture data are intentionally retained.
archive_policy.permitted_tooling: Existing executed native Python/controller/shell inputs, all preparation-pinned nativeq modules, inherited executed bootstrap/decoder-proof/adapter/rebinding inputs and frozen historical decoder data are stored inert as mode0644. Preserving them authorizes no execution.
archive_policy.source_metadata: Only the current hash-only 505-input ledger and immutable qualification receipt are retained; no full production-source, workspace or checker-input snapshot/copy.
archive_policy.private_inputs: Only exact effective per-mode ghostty.conf and Cyril config.toml are allowed verification configs. No entire isolated HOME, workspace, runtime, usage database, credentials or cookie is copied. Private Xauthority dirs observed empty; original preparation says owned cookie removed.
archive_policy.logs: Exact ghostty.log, xvfb.log and owned Cyril product log are retained for both modes; no full HOME/DB dump.
archive_policy.portable_references: Every included origin_path and byte-identical origin_alias resolves to its relative arcname via members. Native numeric scene/export/PNG basenames remain unchanged under native/<mode>. Raw absolute references remain historical; do not edit the originals to relocate them.
archive_policy.no_new_gate: Packaging creates no native PASS/waiver, pixel oracle, source qualification, host/runtime execution or new controls. Main owns the separate layer-combining native-supported-controls-evidence.json outside this archive.
archive_policy.archive_hash_binding: Final compressed archive SHA256/bytes live in native-supported-controls-packaging-receipt.json outside the archive to avoid a digest cycle.

self_digest_policy.exception: Only the index self-entry has null bytes and SHA256. External packaging receipt binds final archive/index/allowlist bytes and hashes; receipt digest is supplied to the integration owner, never embedded in itself.
self_digest_policy.allowlist_self_entry: Contains names only, including index and itself; complete allowlist bytes/hash are in index.

source_binding.limit: 505-input descriptor is not a Git tree/commit, final publication identity or source_revision alias. Before/after MATCH values are preserved historical runtime receipts; packaging does not rerun them.

raw_capture_status_preservation.later_review_layer: Both byte-identical independent review reports are separate later evidence; their26 visual-only literal NOT_PROVEN limits remain intact. No record in this archive issues a new whole-run native PASS.
raw_capture_status_preservation.main_technical_gate_owner: Main; separate active native-supported-controls-evidence.json is intentionally not read or archived by this data packager.

reproduction_inputs_and_external_prerequ.native_tooling: native/controller-snapshot/{native-,original-}/ plus tooling/native-qualification/nativeq/ and tooling/gui-lease/; native Main GO retained at preparation/native-main-go.json. Originals keep exact one-shot paths and authorization checks; this archive is inert evidence, not authority to rerun.
reproduction_inputs_and_external_prerequ.historical_tooling: tooling/inherited-{cadence,original}/, historical-decoder/ and preparation/ preserve exact decoder/bootstrap proof inputs and approved bounded rebindings. Historical pyte/libvterm evidence is not used as native PNG qualification.
historical_decoder_dependencies: installed libvterm.so; original resolved path/hash appears verbatim in historical-decoder/zj0m-current-width-offline-completion.txt

external_qualified_product.runtime_verification: Hash original before launch, copy privately per mode, hash staged executable, hash original post-run

reproduction_inputs_and_external_prerequ.external_source505: Reproduction requires the separately qualified source/build matching source_binding; product/source bytes deliberately absent.
reproduction_inputs_and_external_prerequ.path_relocation: Use original path bindings or explicitly derive a new separately reviewed rebinding/authorization; do not silently rewrite or reuse the retained consumed GO for another run.
reproduction_inputs_and_external_prerequ.untested_by_packaging: No extracted tool, historical decoder, Python helper, bootstrap, product binary, native session or system-runtime version probe was executed.

metadata_pin_comparisons.scope: Existing ledger/preparation/image pin and gzip raw-hash metadata comparisons only, not execution or proof reruns.

selection_inventory.scope: Complete recursive name/stat inventory of original run root; individually declared preparation/tooling/qualification/review origins outside it. No directories copied wholesale.

excluded.reason: Staged product executable; receipt hash retained, executable bytes deliberately not read or packaged.

selection_inventory.separately_published_layers: Existing deterministic/source qualification and historical burst FAIL, pre-C6 ASSERT_FAIL and reviewed-cadence PASS archives are not nested or relabeled. Only exact historical reproduction inputs/receipts needed by the included tooling are selected.

secret_category_inspection.method: Inspected inventory categories, effective verification configs and included text/gzip-native-export bytes for PEM keys, common provider key formats, literal authorization/credential assignments and Xauth cookie assignments; no candidate values emitted. PNG bytes checked only for actual PNG/IHDR metadata, not interpreted as a literal-cell/pixel oracle.
secret_category_inspection.scope_limit: Heuristic content inspection plus exact category exclusion, not a general secret-proof guarantee or redaction pass; original raw inputs never rewritten.

optional_unavailable_artifacts.disposition: No wrapper stdout/stderr/elapsed log reconstructed. Original handoff retains wrapper-reported1068.07seconds; per-mode Ghostty/Xvfb/product logs, complete result receipts and exact lease-drain receipt are included.

members.self_digest_exception: Only this self-entry is null. Final bytes/hash are bound by the external packaging receipt.

operations_not_performed: Source505 path/hash checks or mutation/rebinding execution
claim_limits: No invented focus-entry/back UI control, same-process color control or four native launches
No new pixel oracle, waiver, defect fix or stronger literal visual claim
Historical capture PENDING and visual-only26NOT_PROVEN statuses preserved; Main owns combined gate
